description: This file defines a database driver for the Frontbase database system within the ADOdb abstraction layer, including classes for database connection and recordset handling specific to Frontbase.

classes.name: ADODB_fbsql
classes.description: Database connection class for Frontbase, handling connection management, metadata retrieval, and SQL execution.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_fbsql
classes.description: Represents a recordset returned by Frontbase database queries, providing methods for data fetching and navigation.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID for the current connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last SQL statement.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of database names available on the server.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Constructs a SQL CONCAT expression with provided arguments.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database server.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database server.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a database for the current connection.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the database.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ADORecordSet_fbsql class, initializes fetch mode.

methods.name: _initrs
methods.description: Initializes the recordset's row and field counts.

methods.name: FetchField
methods.description: Fetches metadata about a specific field in the result set.

methods.name: _seek
methods.description: Moves the internal pointer to a specific row in the result set.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row of data from the result set.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Determines the ADODB type for a given database field.
